teaser: The Kickstarter plan: a sovereign website on a Raspberry Pi or a tablet, five tiers from £50 to £1,000, local AI on the Pro tiers.
core_idea: Launch Sovereign Website on Kickstarter as an appliance, a sovereign website on a Raspberry Pi or an Android tablet the owner holds, the Pro tiers running a local AI model that can build the site on the device and run other tasks, in five tiers from £50 to £1,000, the Pi cheaper than the tablet at each level, the UK as the base goal and countries as stretch goals, launching alone on open source.

nodes.label: The appliance
nodes.summary: A site on a device you hold.

A Raspberry Pi as a host

quotes.text: That changes what the device is. It is not only where the site lives; it is where the site can be made.
So the honest design is that the Pi is a host, not the only host
